rewrite_power: Write the integrand as a power of x.
split_fraction: Divide each numerator term by x.
integrate: Apply the standard integral rules to each term.
constant: Add an arbitrary integration constant C.
substitute: Set u equal to the inner expression.
rewrite: Write the integral in terms of u.
substitute_back: Replace u with the original expression.
correct: Your answer is mathematically equivalent to the solution.
incorrect: Check your answer, or reveal the solution.
invalid: Check your brackets, functions and operators.
missing_constant: Add an arbitrary integration constant, such as C.
service_error: The request could not finish. Try again shortly.
expired: This practice session has expired. Reload the page to start again.
unsupported: Choose an available topic and level.
preview: Practice uses the server generator. Results are temporary and are not saved to your account.
availability: Basic integrals and substitution are available at levels 1 and 2. Other options are not available yet.
factor: Write the polynomial as a squared factor.
identity: Apply the trigonometric identity to the integrand.
substitution_integral: Apply the substitution shown below the integral.
nested_substitution: Apply the second substitution inside the first.
parts: Apply integration by parts: integrate one factor and differentiate the other.
repeat_parts: Apply integration by parts to the remaining integral.
solve_cycle: Add the remaining integral to both sides, then divide by two.
partial_fractions: Write the rational function as partial fractions.
polynomial_division: Divide the numerator by the denominator before splitting the remainder.
evaluate_bounds: Evaluate the antiderivative at the upper bound and subtract its value at the lower bound.
definite_value: Simplify the result. A definite integral has no integration constant.
feedback_power_rule: Check the power rule. Raise the power by one, then divide by the new power.
feedback_trig_sign: Check the sign. The integral of sin(x) is -cos(x), and the integral of cos(x) is sin(x).
feedback_chain_factor: Check the constant factor from the inner function. Differentiate your answer to compare it with the integrand.
feedback_log_absolute: Use ln|x| instead of ln(x). The integrand is also defined where x is negative.
feedback_split_product: Do not integrate each factor of a product separately. Use substitution or integration by parts.
feedback_parts_sign: Check the sign in the parts formula: subtract the integral of v du from uv.
feedback_cycle_factor: Divide by two after you move the repeated integral to the other side.
feedback_partial_fraction_sign: Check the signs of your partial fractions. Add them together to compare with the integrand.
feedback_definite_not_evaluated: Evaluate your antiderivative at both bounds and subtract. The answer is a number.
feedback_bounds_reversed: Subtract the value at the lower bound from the value at the upper bound.
feedback_definite_constant: Remove the constant. A definite integral has no integration constant.
general_hint: Differentiate your answer and compare it with the integrand, or reveal the solution.
general_hint_definite: Check your antiderivative, then evaluate it at both bounds, or reveal the solution.
describe_region: Describe the region with bounds for each variable.
describe_polar: Describe the region in polar coordinates.
write_iterated: Write the double integral as an iterated integral.
reverse_order: Reverse the order of integration. Use the same region with the other variable outside.
polar_change: Change to polar coordinates: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ and dA = r dr dθ.
integrate_inner: Integrate the inner integral. Keep the outer variable constant.
integrate_outer: Integrate the result between the outer bounds.
check_other: Check the value with the other set-up of the same region.
multiple_value: Simplify the result. This is the exact value of the integral.
feedback_missing_jacobian: Include the factor r. In polar coordinates dA = r dr dθ.
general_hint_multiple: Check the bounds of each integral, then integrate the inner integral first, or reveal the solution.
